about.photoAlt: Justin J De La Cruz, smiling, arms crossed, in an office setting.
paragraphs: I’m an engineer and founder based in Puerto Rico, working across software, hardware, and product development. As a competitive fencer, I identified a problem in a sport I know deeply and built JustIn to create the technology I wanted to exist.
I enjoy tackling ambiguous problems, building end-to-end systems, testing them with real users, and using what I learn to drive the next iteration.
